name: Qwen-Image 2.1
format: ComfyUI API-format prompt graph: {node_id: {class_type, inputs}}. POST it as the `prompt` field of POST /prompt.
model: Qwen-Image 2.1 (Qwen), ComfyUI repack Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1 (int8 convrot weights, int8 Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder)

licence.name: Qwen Research License (outputs belong to the person; the weights are research-only)

source: The graph that painted the website examples rain-ruins, rain-ruins-wild, snow-lanterns and echo-now/then on the user's Mac (.scratch/examples/graphs/rain-ruins.request.json), with placeholders. Same sampling as Comfy-Org's template image_qwen_image_2_1_t2i (25 steps, cfg 1, euler, simple), except its bf16 text encoder.
negative_prompt: TextEncodeQwenImage21's negative_prompt is left empty (cfg 1.0); its second output is the KSampler's negative.
notes: TextEncodeQwenImage21 is a stock ComfyUI node (comfy_extras/nodes_qwen.py), but only in recent ComfyUI: AutoPaper offers this model only when the server has it.
The CLIPLoader type 'qwen_image' loads the Qwen3-VL text encoder for Qwen-Image 2.1. Its 'resolution' input only sizes reference images, which this text-to-image graph has none of.

Qwen-Image 2.1's VAE is 16x, so its decoder sees a quarter of the tokens an 8x VAE does: AutoPaper asks for up to 2752 a side and 4,300,800 pixels (the model card's sizes; core/src/providers/comfyui.rs MODEL_LIMITS).
Qwen-Image 2.1 returns RGBA images (alpha >= 236); AutoPaper's image pipeline flattens them to RGB.
filename_prefix 'autopaper/wallpaper' makes ComfyUI write into output/autopaper/.

measured_seconds.2576x1664: 536 through the engine, M5 Max, 2026-10-06 (~20 s a step)
